item_short_desc: Rothco’s Ambidextrous Tactical Belt Holster provides a reliable and convenient way to carry your concealed carry weapon. Designed for both left and right-handed draw, this CCW holster is adaptable and versatile. The adjustable hard plastic thumb break ensures a secure fit for most medium to large frame pistols, including models like the Glock 19 and Ruger LCP. Featuring a plastic slide and steel belt clip, you can adjust the holster’s position to your comfort, whether it’s worn on the left or right side.
description: Rothco’s Ambidextrous Tactical Belt Holster provides a reliable and convenient way to carry your concealed carry weapon. Designed for both left and right-handed draw, this CCW holster is adaptable and versatile. The adjustable hard plastic thumb break ensures a secure fit for most medium to large frame pistols, including models like the Glock 19 and Ruger LCP. Featuring a plastic slide and steel belt clip, you can adjust the holster’s position to your comfort, whether it’s worn on the left or right side. The holster also includes a single magazine pouch secured with a hook and loop closure, making it easy to access and reload your firearm. An adjustable hard insert retention strap guarantees your weapon stays securely in place. The holster fits belts up to 2 inches wide and is an ideal accessory for those who need a practical and secure way to carry their firearm. Durable and dependable, Rothco’s tactical belt holster ensures safety and accessibility at all times.
